items.title: Multiple vulnerabilities, including BlockStrap RCE
items.summary: Adobe released a security update addressing critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities, including a template engine injection (CVE-2026-103849, BlockStrap) allowing unauthenticated arbitrary code execution. This update requires a manual patch and new installations remain vulnerable.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a zero-day vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution in Magento and Adobe Commerce, with attacks starting on September 4th. Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) for this CVSS 10.0 vulnerability on September 7th.

items.title: Multiple vulnerabilities, including RCE and privilege escalation
items.summary: Adobe released a security update resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. This bulletin also advises applying the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650.

items.title: Multiple vulnerabilities, including Incorrect Authorization and Stored XSS
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, addressing critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. These include an incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-71362) leading to privilege escalation and stored cross-site scripting vulnerabilities (e.g., CVE-2026-48414) leading to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Security Update for Critical and Important Magento Vulnerabilities
items.summary: Adobe released a security update (APSB25-71) to resolve critical and important Magento vulnerabilities that could allow hackers to execute programs or access confidential data. While no active exploits were known at the time, immediate updates were recommended.

items.title: SessionReaper: Unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: SessionReaper, an unauthenticated Remote Code Execution vulnerability, entered active exploitation in October 2026, six weeks after Adobe's emergency patch. Many stores remained vulnerable at the time of active attacks.
